Let the vertices be
\[
P_i=(2\sqrt3\cos\theta_i,\;2\sin\theta_i).
\]
The centroid condition gives
\[
\sum \cos\theta_i=0,\qquad \sum \sin\theta_i=0.
\]
Hence the three unit vectors are spaced \(120^\circ\) apart.

The ellipse is the image of the unit circle under the affine map \((x,y)\mapsto (2\sqrt3 x, 2y)\), which scales areas by
\[
2\sqrt3\cdot 2=4\sqrt3.
\]
The triangle on the unit circle is equilateral with area
\[
\frac{3\sqrt3}{4}.
\]
Thus the area of \(\triangle ABC\) is
\[
4\sqrt3\cdot \frac{3\sqrt3}{4}=9.
\]

\[
\boxed{9}
\]
